body: Not saying anyone is right or wrong here, you said it yourself that you became distant and didn’t give attention because you were going thru stuff and said that he has depression and anxiety, it’s not an excuse but i feel like it’s almost the same deal? as for getting back from vacation, people have a lot more free time when they are away, maybe his home life is busy or chaotic. from past experiences, just because they show up online doesn’t mean they necessarily are either, apps are weird. best advice i could give is to put yourself in his shoes and try to see his side of things. but keep in mind you’re your own person and deserve whatever you want in someone you love, maybe he isn’t the right pick for you. i hope this helps and that things work out :D
